title: Ext is computed by the signed dual Koszul cohomology
statement: Let A be a commutative ring whose module category has a derived category, I an ideal, and f:Fin r -> A a Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence] generating I. There is an A-linear equivalence Ext^r_A(A/I,A) -> H^r(L), where L is the signed dual Koszul complex [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex]. This assertion does not mention the conormal module or a determinant identification.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, computation of derived Hom by a finite free Koszul resolution

proof.text: Obtain P with P.complex=koszulComplex A r f from exists_koszul_projective_resolution. Destructure P and substitute the complex equality, keeping its projectivity, augmentation and quasi-isomorphism proofs.

Apply exists_ext_signed_dual_homology_equiv to this projective resolution, Y=A and L=koszulDualComplex A r f in degree r. The component isomorphisms are identities. The differential compatibility is the defining formula of koszulDualBoundary, and follows by simp after unfolding the Koszul dual definitions.

lean.statement: theorem exists_koszul_ext_dual_homology_equiv (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) : Nonempty (Abelian.Ext (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)) (ModuleCat.of A A) r ≃ₗ[A] (koszulDualComplex A r f).homology r)
